verdict.rationale: Codex CLI docs explicitly mention exploring unfamiliar code and planning changes within a repository, and it can inspect code, run local dev tools, and review diffs/commits — supporting codebase orientation. However, there's no dedicated codebase-mapping/visualization feature, no evidence of dependency-graph or architecture-summary generation, and community feedback focuses on agentic task execution rather than comprehension aids. Missing for 10: dedicated codebase-map/architecture-overview feature, independent hands-on evidence of effectively onboarding to unfamiliar large codebases, and richer navigation/search tooling beyond terminal chat resume.
